project: SearchLab: Learning When to Rerank Under Limited Compute

splits.fit: official train, excluding groups overlapping dev
splits.validation: official dev; repeated use means development data, never final unbiased result
splits.test: sealed in original archive until experiment configuration is frozen

bm25.tokenization: NFKC, casefold, Unicode word regex; no stemming or stopwords

retrieval.fusion: reciprocal rank fusion, equal weights, rank starts at 1
retrieval.candidate_policy: Persist a single RRF-ranked top-20 pool per query; skip retains RRF order and rerank reorders precisely this pool

evaluation.relevance_gain: 1 if raw grade > 0 else 0; preserve raw grades on disk
evaluation.metric_rationale: The data audit found all train grades=1 but dev grades include 1 and 2; binarize before constructing gains for a consistent target. Label explicitly as binary NDCG@10, not directly comparable with graded BEIR leaderboard values.
evaluation.idcg: all positive qrels for the query, not only retrieved candidates
evaluation.unjudged: treated as grade 0 for benchmark scoring; acknowledge incomplete judgments
evaluation.budget_mode: fixed call fraction, floor(fraction * query_count), report actual fraction
evaluation.oracle: diagnostic only; rank by actual delta; include fixed-fraction and at-most-budget variants
evaluation.bootstrap: paired resampling of duplicate-query groups, 1000 replicates; report 95% interval
evaluation.cost_proxy: one rerank action on 20 candidates; fixed configuration does not imply identical latency
evaluation.latency: uncached live model execution, warmup excluded, record CPU, threads, lengths, p50/p95, separate model load time

routing.classification_baseline: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression, C=1.0, max_iter=1000; target delta>gain_epsilon
routing.regression_baseline: DecisionTreeRegressor, max_depth=3, min_samples_leaf=20, random_state=42; target delta
routing.heuristic: rerank smallest RRF top1-top2 score margin first; query-ID tie break
routing.preprocessing: fit on routing training folds only
routing.disagreement_heuristic: rerank smallest BM25/dense top-20 Jaccard first; query-ID tie break
